name: liability_concentration
description: Sportsbook read tool (tenant-scoped). Returns the events carrying the most concentrated book liability for the caller's tenant: per (event, selection), total stake, total potential payout (the book's exposure if that selection wins), and bet count, ordered by exposure. Typed and enumerated — bounded parameters only, no caller-supplied SQL. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to report on. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar before the tool runs).

top_k.description: Number of highest-exposure (event, selection) rows to return (default 10, capped at 50).

min_stake.description: Only report (event, selection) groups whose total stake is at least this (default 0).
